Your tax-inclusive payment is allocated by the duration of the current server quota window within the billing period. That allocation is multiplied by the observed usage percentage. Weekly usage is never multiplied by an entire monthly payment. The complete quota window must fall within the saved billing dates (Asia/Seoul, end date excluded). Stale readings or unexplained limit changes suspend the calculation. Zero payments remain zero. This is a reference for utilization, not an API cost, savings, financial return, or measured work quality. Missing past windows are not treated as zero. Payments and tiers are independent.
